Shaanxi Taibai Mountain National Forest Park is located in Baoji, Shaanxi, the northern foot of the Qinling Mountains, Mei County, Taibai County, Zhouzhi County three counties.
It is the main peak of the famous Qinling Mountains in China, and it is also the first peak in the eastern part of China's mainland, with an altitude of 3771.2 meters.
The Qinling Mountains are a natural barrier between the south and north of China, and are also the watershed of the Yangtze River and the Yellow River.

As the main peak of the Qinling Mountains, Taibai Mountain has more unique natural geographical conditions, its towering majestic momentum and rapidly changing climate posture have given people a layer of mystery since ancient times, and it is more desirable for Chinese and foreign scientists and literati.

Taibai Mountain is famous for its high, cold, dangerous, strange, beautiful and mysterious characteristics, and is dominant in China. "Taibai Snow June Day" is one of the famous eight scenic spots in Guanzhong.

Yuan's "Unification Chronicles" contains: "The mountain (Taibai Mountain) is extremely high, the snow is always covered, and the hope is bright"; In Wang Xin's "Three Talents Picture Meeting" in the Ming Dynasty, the year-round snow cover of Taibai Mountain is depicted: "There is often snow on the top of the mountain, and it is still rotten in midsummer." However, the scenery of the snow in the middle of summer in Taibai Mountain is wonderful, the time is long, and it is a wonder, and the silver light is shining, and it can be seen for hundreds of miles.
It is not an exaggeration or fiction, and it has indeed come from a long time.

Taibai Mountain is the best eco-tourism scenic spot due to its geological landforms, mountain glaciers, beautiful springs, forest communities, celestial landscapes, exotic flowers and grasses, and cultural history.
Taibai Mountain is the main peak of the Qinling Mountains, which is the climatic dividing line between the south and north of China, and the watershed of the Yangtze River and the Yellow River.
It is like a tall and wide wall, blocking the air flow from the south to the north, so that the climate of the north and south has a clear difference.

According to the characteristics of climate and vegetation, Taibai Mountain is divided into five obvious climate zones: warm temperate zone, temperate zone, cold temperate zone, cold zone, and alpine cold zone.
The temperature of Taibai Mountain is ever-changing, and the ancient poems say: the middle of summer is a hot day, and the night is accompanied by snow sleep.
Spring flowers and autumn leaves pave the road, and the four o'clock is in an instant.

What's more: "At the foot of the mountain, the mountains are in midsummer, the foothills are bright in autumn, the top of the mountain is cold, the red cliffs are yellow, green, white, blue and purple, and it is difficult to distinguish between spring, summer, autumn and winter." ".

The unique natural environment of Taibai Mountain has given birth to a variety of biological populations, with a wide variety of species, ancient origins, and is a natural species gene bank, with more than 302 species of animals, more than 230 species of birds, and more than 1,900 species of plants, known as "Asian Natural Botanical Garden" and "Chinese Natural Zoo".
